crewNotes.text: Figures compiled from UAE federal customs guidance and pending verification against the exact authority page. Operating crew should confirm any crew-specific treatment with UAE customs.

rules.text: Non-Muslim travellers aged 18 or over may bring in up to 4 litres of alcohol, or 2 cartons of beer (24 cans each, not exceeding 355 ml per can), for personal use.
Travellers aged 18 or over entering the UAE must declare cash or equivalent monetary instruments of AED 60,000 or more.

declarationRequirements.text: Gifts and personal goods up to AED 3,000 in value are admitted free of duty; goods above that value, and any restricted items, must be declared.

rules.text: The traveller tobacco allowance is 400 cigarettes, plus 50 cigars, plus 500 grams of tobacco.

disclaimer: Verify current requirements with the relevant authority and airline procedures before travel.
